story: Until 2026-12-29 (32 days), options price HDFCBANK to move about ±5.9%, roughly 809 to 910. In the past, the price ended inside the range priced this way 60% of the time.
HDFCBANK has actually been moving about 1.80% a day this past month: on the high side for it against the past year.

For the 2026-12-29 expiry, the biggest pile of call positions is at 900 (+5.0% away) and the biggest pile of put positions is at 800 (-6.7%). Option sellers defend these levels, so price often slows near them, but they shift as positions change.
Options are cheap compared with how much HDFCBANK has actually been moving: they price 25.0% a year while the last month realised 28.5%.

iv.simple: Options on HDFCBANK are priced for moves of about 1.58% a day. That is on the high side for HDFCBANK compared with the past year.
iv.analyst: 30-day constant-maturity ATM IV 25.0%: 85th percentile of 1 year, 72nd of all days since 2019-01-01.

vrp.simple: Options are cheap compared with how much HDFCBANK has actually been moving: they price 25.0% a year while the last month realised 28.5%.
vrp.analyst: IV30 - RV21 = -3.5 vol points, 15th percentile of the past year. Since 2019-01-01, IV30 was above the volatility that actually followed over the next 21 sessions on 67% of days: option sellers are usually paid a premium for carrying the risk, and the gap is what that premium looks like today.

term.simple: Longer-dated options on HDFCBANK cost more than near ones: the normal, calm shape.

skew.simple: Calls and puts the same distance from the price cost about the same (gap -0.5 vol points): no strong demand for either protection or upside. Against the past year, that gap is normal for HDFCBANK.
skew.analyst: 25-delta risk reversal -0.47 vol pts (front month), 52nd percentile of the past year. More negative = more demand for downside insurance relative to upside.

realised.simple: HDFCBANK has actually been moving about 1.80% a day this past month: on the high side for it against the past year.
realised.analyst: RV21 28.5% (87th percentile of the past year), RV5 44.7%, RV63 26.1%; RV5/RV63 compression at the 90th percentile.

oi.simple: For the 2026-12-29 expiry, the biggest pile of call positions is at 900 (+5.0% away) and the biggest pile of put positions is at 800 (-6.7%). Option sellers defend these levels, so price often slows near them, but they shift as positions change.
oi.analyst: Front-expiry PCR (OI) 0.63; all-expiry OI PCR at the 87th percentile of the past year. Today's change: calls +2,451,800, puts +1,311,700 (OI units, i.e. shares or index quantity). A high PCR in India mostly reflects put writing, so it is read as crowding, not as a signal.

futures.simple: HDFCBANK futures trade 2.3 points above the price itself. That premium works out to 3.1% a year, within its usual range for the past year.
futures.analyst: Near-month basis +2.3, annualised carry 3.1% (16th percentile of the past year; its 1-year median 6.7%). Last 5 sessions (price x OI, same contracts day to day): Short covering, Long unwinding, Short covering, Short covering, Short build-up. Build-up labels describe what happened to positions; they do not say who is right.

move.simple: Until 2026-12-29 (32 days), options price HDFCBANK to move about ±5.9%, roughly 809 to 910. In the past, the price ended inside the range priced this way 60% of the time.
move.analyst: ATM straddle / forward = 5.88% (forward 859.4). Scored on 1,956 days since 2019-01-01 against the official close on each expiry; a straddle is the market's mean absolute move, so about 57% inside is what a fair price would give.

notes.text: HDFCBANK has used 18% of its market-wide position limit (the ban starts at 95%).
Lot size changes from 650 to 750 for the 2027-01-25 contracts (the exchange has already listed them so).
